PR O DU C T L IF E C Y C LE S T AT EM EN T
ACS550, ACH550 and ACQ550
General purpose drive ACS550, HVAC drive ACH550 and water and
waste water drive ACQ550
The ABB life cycle management model is designed to manage an orderly transition to new
replacement products or to choose from various lifetime extending services. At the same time the
model ensures access to continuing support for our customers
Active
Classic
Full range of life cycle services and support
Limited
Obsolete
Limited range of life cycle
services and support
Replacement and
end-of-life services
Current life cycle status
ACS550/ACH550/ACQ550 product series are in the
Limited life cycle phase since 1.1.2024, according to the
ABB life cycle model outlined above.
Life cycle plan
It is planned to keep the product series in the Limited
phase until the end of 2024, after which it will be
transferred to the Obsolete phase.
Product availability in Classic phase
Europe, Asia, Middle East, Africa, and Americas:
The product is no longer available.
China:
Please, contact your ABB representative for availability.
Recommended actions
It is recommended to replace the
ACS550/ACH550/ACQ550 with a latest generation
product family.
Product types concerned
ACS550-01/-02
ACH550-01/-02
ACH550-UH/-xBxR/-PxR/-VxR
ACQ550-Ux/-CC/-Px
ACS550-Ux/-CC/-Px
ACx550 ETO*
*ETO = Engineered to Order
Note: x designates a wildcard and covers all offered variants
Please contact your local ABB for migration to latest
generation equivalent products.
Further information
For more information on drives life cycle management
and available services contact your local ABB
organization or at www.abb.com/drives.
